name: First Stage Booster (Core)
summary: Reusable liquid-propellant first stage powered by nine Merlin 1D engines in an Octaweb cluster.
function: Accelerates the upper stack through the dense atmosphere to MECO (~65–85 km, ~1.8–2.2 km/s), then flips, reenters, and lands propulsively on an ASDS droneship or RTLS landing zone.
materials: Friction-stir-welded aluminum-lithium (Al-Li) propellant tanks with a common bulkhead separating subcooled LOX (upper) and RP-1 (lower), plus thermal protection around the Octaweb.

specs.label: Reusable Dry Mass
specs.source: Public Block 5 reusable dry mass estimate (22.2–27.2 t)

history: Block 5 introduced a bolted titanium Octaweb thermal shield, upgraded heat-resistant raceway covers, and reinforced landing hardware, enabling single boosters to exceed 20 orbital flights.
